title: Individual identity evidence verification and document custody
workflow: Capture applicant evidence through secure channel with explicit lawful basis
Validate allowed document type, quality, expiration and consistency
Record separate machine observation and authoritative issuer validation where available
Escalate authenticity mismatch, expired documents and identity collision
Store approved result and reviewer identity separately from protected source bytes
Reassess expired or revoked identity claims according to institution policy
invariants: OCR extraction is only an observation, not governmental authenticity proof
No third-party provider availability may be fabricated; verified method must be recorded
Never publish raw document bytes, biometric vectors or account IDs to general events
Reference document images through access-controlled encrypted storage and retention class
Verification of one document does not imply proof of residence, source of funds or sanction clearance
Expire/revoke evidence without deleting legally required historical verification decisions
acceptance_tests: Unverified OCR result cannot set official verification status
Unauthorized operator cannot download protected document
Different person's document detected as mismatch
Revoked evidence blocks new proof-dependent case approval
gate: Approved document list, permitted verifier/legal basis, issuer integration evidence and privacy/security review.
